fix(update): preserve admission and finalization contracts
fix(update): close fresh-admission and control-store races
fix(update): preserve sealed managed handoff startup
fix(update): publish control databases with Windows durability
fix(update): retain executor ownership during service recovery
fix(update): initialize control storage without optional native bindings
fix(update): retain interrupted-store recovery when integrating main
test(update): align platform and merge workflow fixtures
test(update): verify settled children and isolate deletion timing

4. 文档承诺的 supersede 路径（`openclaw update` 触发 stale row 清理）实际走 `already-current` early-return，不进入 supersede 分支。
5. 当前状态：升级本身成功（9.3 跑着，4 个官方插件对齐，re2 按新 ABI 重编译），只剩这条 stale run 显示残留。

```js
if (parentActivation !== undefined && inspection.serviceUpdateVerdict?.kind !== "absent" && inspection.offline !== true)
  throw new Error("The update parent owns Gateway activation...")
```
